summary: Frontend UI verification of Admin Dashboard exhibitor row layout and multi-stall booking. Admin login OK. Exhibitor table now has 'STALL · STATUS · ACTIONS' column with stall number + status badge + payment badge + inline action buttons (btn-mini) below the stall name — NO '⋯' dropdown observed. Multi-select booking on the Book-a-Stall map works: selecting two available markers (B1, B2) applies is-selected class, shows selection bar with 'Book 2 stalls' + Clear; opening the form shows title 'Book 2 stalls', readonly Stalls='B1, B2', Number of Stalls=2; submitting creates ONE confirmed exhibitor with Stall cell showing 'B1, B2' and both markers become status-booked. Payment toggle verified: Unpaid→Paid, button label toggles Mark Paid↔Mark Unpaid, badge updates. Cleanup: created TEST rows deleted after test.

integration_issues.issue: Total Amount field does NOT default to the summed list rate for the selected stall(s) — it renders empty with placeholder 'e.g. 12000'. The spec explicitly requires Total Amount to default to the summed list rate. Number of Stalls and comma-joined Stalls value are correctly prefilled.

action_items: In StallBookingPanel.jsx booking form, prefill data-testid='booking-amount' with the sum of the selected stalls' list rates (currently blank).

Optional: Approve/Reject inline buttons for pending exhibitors could not be exercised because admin-created bookings auto-confirm. Consider adding a way to test this via a public exhibitor registration flow, or seed a pending exhibitor for regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Booking form Total Amount not auto-populated from stall rates despite selection — user has to type the amount manually every time. UX bug given spec.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted two TEST exhibitors: 'TEST Multi Co' on stalls B1,B2 and 'TEST Company Two' on B3. Data cleaned up at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All two feature changes are otherwise functional. Only remaining gap is Total Amount default in the multi-stall booking form. When testing, click the tabs via '.admin-tab' locator (they are divs, not <button>s). Marker testids are book-marker-<STALLNUM>, e.g. book-marker-B1. Payment toggle testid: payment-toggle-<exhibitorId>. Delete testid: delete-<exhibitorId>.
rca of the issue: Total Amount empty: the useEffect/state that recomputes selected stall rates likely writes to a variable other than the amount input state, or the sum defaults to 0/'' when the panel opens from multi-select. Check StallBookingPanel.jsx open-form handler — it should compute sum(selectedStalls.map(s => s.rate)) and set the amount state before rendering the input.
